Messages.Author: AL
Messages.Body:
Can Danielle's special be used more than once in one's untap phase?
Nothing indicates that it could not, but just to be sure...

Say, she has one blood, and good retainers Robert Carter and Charnas
the Imp. She pays the upkeep of Robert, drops to 0, gains 2 blood,
which are Heidelberged away, gains yet 2 blood, takes a damage from
Charnas, and moves the last blood to Ramona and gains 2 blood once
more. Possible?

-Antero

Ps. and of course in this case she should be brought to controlled
empty via Gather in first place :)

Powerbases, etc.
